references.text: The context of the tithe that the Levites receive from the children of Israel, and their duty to give a tenth of the tithe as an offering to the Lord.
The basic law concerning the tithe of the land, which belongs to the Lord and is holy to him.
Regulations regarding the tithe and how it should be used, including support for the Levites who have no inheritance share.
Nehemiah organizes the collection of tithes and offerings for the priests and Levites, in accordance with the Law of Moses.
The prophet Malachi urges the people to bring the full tithe into the storehouse as an act of faithfulness toward the Lord.
The Epistle to the Hebrews refers to the Levites' right to receive tithes from the people according to the law, and connects this to the priesthood of Melchizedek.
